name: razorpay-ace-marketplace
description: Shop across Indian D2C merchants through the Razorpay ACE Marketplace MCP server, including product search, cart management, hosted checkout, and order status.

interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT to the Razorpay ACE Marketplace MCP server for multi-merchant commerce across Indian D2C brands. Users can search products, inspect filters and product details, manage carts, create Razorpay hosted checkout links, and check order status. Sign in with your Razorpay ACE Marketplace account (OAuth) to connect.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me shop across Razorpay ACE Marketplace merchants.
